# HCI Swiss

Official public commercial information for HCI Swiss, operated under FK HERMES INTERNATIONAL.

Canonical landing page: https://fkhermes23-byte.github.io/HCISWISS.com/
Official website: https://www.hciswiss.com
Machine-readable offer catalog: https://fkhermes23-byte.github.io/HCISWISS.com/catalog.json

## Scope

HCI Swiss supports non-clinical digital operations and documentation workflows for care-service organisations and independent professionals.

## Available commercial pathways

- CareOps workflow review
- Scoped implementation
- Partnership and licensing qualification

All services require qualification. Public information is not proof of availability in every geography, regulatory approval, a contract, or a guaranteed outcome.
